backend/servers/api-server/src/services/push/apns.rs:258-283 — send_apns_one treats HTTP 410 Gone (app uninstalled) as a stale token ONLY when ApnsErrorBody JSON parses; the Err arm at line 275-282 returns (false, false), losing the eviction signal when the body is empty/truncated/non-JSON. Per Apple's APNs HTTP/2 spec, HTTP 410 alone is the authoritative Unregistered signal — body `{"reason":"Unregistered"}` is confirmation detail. Current failure mode: stale token stays in device_push_tokens until something else evicts it, wasting every future push attempt on that user's uninstalled device. Fix: branch on status.as_u16() == 410 BEFORE body parse — mark expired=true on 410 regardless of body outcome; keep the body parse for logging the reason.
